proof_scope: Build an exact clean GitHub checkout, exercise real Docker interfaces with independent four-format readback, reject early/late bad inputs, replay offline, and verify a ZIP including .git.

claims.proves: The recorded candidate, image and packaged repository passed the named synthetic qualification cases.
claims.does_not_prove: Eight-hour compliance, production scale, exhaustive faults, anonymity, or presentation approval.

cases.name: clean-container-and-adversarial-release-gate
command: cd .. && w=$(mktemp -d "$QUALIFICATION_ROOT/clean-XXXXXX") && uv run --extra dev python scripts/qualify_submission.py --output "$w/run" && python3 -c 'import json,sys,hashlib,zipfile; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]+"/QUALIFICATION.json")); assert r["status"] == "PASS"; p=r["archive"]; assert hashlib.sha256(open(p,"rb").read()).hexdigest() == r["archive_sha256"]; z=zipfile.ZipFile(p); assert "oai-trial/.git/HEAD" in z.namelist(); print("QUALIFICATION_PASS "+sys.argv[1])' "$w/run"
